ritual.ironrituals.sun.hint: "Let gold call the dawn and the flower follow its face."
ritual.ironrituals.night.hint: "When blood begs for rest, the sun has no voice."
ritual.ironrituals.deluge.hint: "Five seas, ten leaves and the tear of a floating being."
ritual.ironrituals.dome.hint: "A wall no one sees and everyone respects."
ritual.ironrituals.prison.hint: "What goes in does not always come out."
ritual.ironrituals.arcane_suppression.hi: "When the book falls silent, even the ember forgets its name."
ritual.ironrituals.sanctuary.hint: "Where light guards its own, shadow finds no cradle."
ritual.ironrituals.arcane_spring.hint: "The spring never runs dry if it is named rightly."
ritual.ironrituals.sentinel.hint: "An eye that never sleeps counts the steps of strangers."
ritual.ironrituals.sepulchral_silence.hi: "Where the echo dies, not even the beast of the deep hears its prey's heartbeat."
ritual.ironrituals.inverted_gravity.hint: "When stone forgets its weight, even iron learns to fall towards the clouds."
ritual.ironrituals.time_distortion.hint: "The grain falls slower towards the heart of the hourglass; only the one who turns it does not drown in the sand."
ritual.ironrituals.mirror.hint: "A strange place, desolate and dead, where no one sees or touches you."
ritual.ironrituals.phoenix.hint: "Who dies in flames is born in flames."
ritual.ironrituals.metamorphosis.hint: "That which is made of you walks beside you."
ritual.ironrituals.shrinking.hint: "Small is the one who watches the world from the mushroom."
ritual.ironrituals.scapegoat.hint: "Two hearts beat as one, yet only one feels the blade and the poison."
ritual.ironrituals.temporal_paradox.hint: "The hourglass does not fall; it waits for the thread to snap to return the grain to the top."
ritual.ironrituals.soul_anchor.hint: "What you bind to the soul, death does not unbind."
ritual.ironrituals.silent_echo.hint: "A pulseless form that mimics what once was."
ritual.ironrituals.eternal_bond.hint: "What swore loyalty is never wholly lost."
ritual.ironrituals.planar_nexus.hint: "Grass, burning rock and stone of the end: three worlds through one door."
ritual.ironrituals.intrusion.hint: "A door that is not yours opens when you speak its name."
ritual.ironrituals.astral_projection.hin: "Leave your flesh beside the candles and let your gaze pass through stone like mist."
ritual.ironrituals.eternal_forge.hint: "What fire forges, time does not wear."
ritual.ironrituals.terraforming.hint: "The memory of the earth is malleable when offered the seed of another world."
ritual.ironrituals.custody.hint: "A lock that knows only its master."
